title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 02, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B7.7 (Peaked November 02, 2026 at 06:08 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 403 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Energetic particles are keeping things interesting upstairs! 🛰🔋🚀

Several bright active regions and a prominent filament are visible in today’s solar imagery, while the coronagraph shows no clear CME.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
